body:
- sycl: persistent IQ3_S/IQ3_XXS weight reorder for SYCL decode and prefill

Add persistent reordered weight layouts for IQ3_S and IQ3_XXS. Weights

are reordered once at load time; the reordered MMVQ dot products then

walk dense super-blocks with dp4a and SWAR sign expansion instead of

gathering bits from the interleaved standard layout. Reorder-aware

dequantization feeds the batched prefill GEMMs so prompt processing

Also harden the oneDNN build check: a missing DNNL package or a

CPU-only DNNL build now fails at configure time instead of silently

producing a degraded backend.

Measured on Intel Arc Pro B70 with Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_S (MTP),

-ngl 999 -b 4096 -ub 1024 -fa on:

tg256 @ 0 ctx 12.92 -> 23.54 tok/s (+82%)

tg256 @ 9,216 12.33 -> 21.69 tok/s (+76%)

tg256 @ 64,000 9.76 -> 14.91 tok/s (+53%)

pp8192 833.9 -> 833.6 tok/s (flat)

Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M / Q3_K_M are unchanged within noise (largest delta

-0.5% pp, tg flat), so standard quants are not affected.

The MMVQ GLU fusion widening and rms_norm+scale fusion are

intentionally not part of this change; master already carries them

removing wait as per review request

sycl : fix fusion.cpp line ending
summaryZh: llama.cpp项目通过了一项针对SYCL后端的重大优化，为IQ3_S和IQ3_XXS权重实现了持久化重排布局。通过在加载时对权重进行一次性重排，MMVQ点积运算可以直接利用dp4a和SWAR符号扩展访问密集型超块，在Intel Arc Pro等硬件上将部分模型的生成速度（tg256）提升了50%至82%以上，同时不影响标准量化模型的精度。
